# Check if current song is already liked; if not, keep going to previous song until we find a liked one.
current_song_id = current_song['song_id']
max_steps = 100  # safety limit
steps = 0
while current_song_id not in liked_song_ids and steps < max_steps:
    response = apis.spotify.previous_song(access_token=access_token)
    current_song_id = response['song_id']
    steps += 1
    print(f"Step {steps}: moved to song_id {current_song_id}")

# Get details of the final song

print(f"Reached liked song: {final_song['title']} by {final_song['artist']} (song_id {final_song['song_id']})")
